articles.title: Madras HC dismisses plea challenging gold ring tender
articles.description: The Madras High Court has dismissed a petition challenging the award of a tender to Joyalukkas for supplying one-gram, 22-carat gold rings to babies born in government hospitals under the ‘Thaymaman Thanga Modhiram’ scheme. The post Madras HC dismisses plea challenging gold ring tender appeared first on News Today | First with the news .

articles.title: Beyond Local Markets: How MSMEs Can Unlock Growth Through Exports and GeM
articles.description: New Delhi [India], September 10: MSMEs looking to scale can find growth beyond familiar markets. Exports can open doors to global customers, while the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) can connect businesses with institutional buyers across India.
